guide.summary: Palace museums, a Lake Pichola island excursion and a cultural-centre haveli, with lakeside breakfasts, Rajasthani dinners, a patisserie and bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: None of the official sites checked names a weekly closing day, so plan around stated hours instead: the Crystal Gallery closes at 6.30 pm, while HRH's 2026 site lists the City Palace Museum until 9.00 pm.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: None of the sites checked names a weekly closing day. The Leela and Raffles list their restaurants as open daily, and The Oberoi Udaivilas says The Bar opens seven days a week.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: HRH lists City Palace Museum adult entry at Rs.400 including camera, and the Crystal Gallery at Rs.500 for adults. Bagore Ki Haveli lists Indian adults at Rs.60 and foreigners at Rs.150.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Jagat Niwas Palace needs Rajasthani thali orders 24 hours ahead and releases tables after 15 minutes. The Leela recommends booking Sheesh Mahal in advance for outdoor seating, and Ambrai asks you to reserve a table.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Photography is strictly prohibited in the Crystal Gallery, and Jagat Niwas Palace does not allow outside food or drink.

guide.dek: Pair the City Palace sights with a boat to Jagmandir Island Palace, and book lakeside dinners and thalis at least a day ahead.
intro: Udaipur's City Palace complex holds several separately ticketed sights. HRH Hotels' 2026 site lists the City Palace Museum from 9.00 am to 9.00 pm, with adult entry at Rs.400 including camera, and audio guides in English, German, French and Spanish for Rs.200. Inside Fateh Prakash Palace, the Crystal Gallery shows the Osler crystal Maharana Sajjan Singh ordered in 1877; it opens 9.00 am to 6.30 pm, and photography is strictly prohibited. Outside the palace, the Vintage & Classic Car Collection fills the former Mewar State Motor Garage at the Garden Hotel.

On Lake Pichola, HRH runs excursions from Rameshwar Ghat to Jagmandir Island Palace, passing the City Palace facade, Bagore ki Haveli and Gangaur Ghat. The fare includes the Jagriti heritage exhibition on the island, and you can stay on for a meal at The Darikhana or a drink at the Picholi Bar, both listed from 10:00 am to 10:30 pm. Back on shore at Gangaur Ghat, Bagore Ki Haveli is run by the West Zone Cultural Centre, which lists Indian adult tickets at Rs.60 and foreigner tickets at Rs.150.

Lakeside hotels carry much of the dining. At The Leela Palace Udaipur, Sheesh Mahal serves Rajasthani and North-West Frontier dinners from 7:00 pm, and the hotel recommends booking ahead for outdoor seating; The Dining Room starts breakfast at 7:00 am. The Oberoi Udaivilas lists Suryamahal and Chandni from 7:00 am to 10:30 pm, with Chandni open only from October to March. In the old city, Jagat Niwas Palace asks for Rajasthani thali orders 24 hours ahead and holds tables for 15 minutes, while Ambrai, serving since 1998, asks you to reserve in advance.

For an evening drink, The Library Bar at The Leela opens from 3:00 pm to 11:00 pm, the Global Bar at Jagat Niwas Palace from 11:00, and The Bar at The Oberoi Udaivilas from noon until midnight seven days a week. Raffles Udaipur's undated dining pages list its Patisserie and Tea Room daily from 7.00 am to 11.00 pm, with viennoiserie and cakes baked daily, and The Writers Bar pairs classic cocktails with afternoon tea. None of the sites checked names a weekly closing day.
summaryCards: Start at the City Palace Museum, then take HRH's boat from Rameshwar Ghat to Jagmandir Island Palace, where the fare includes the Jagriti exhibition.
Have breakfast at Jharokha in Jagat Niwas Palace from 07:30 or at The Dining Room at The Leela from 7:00 am, then walk to Bagore Ki Haveli on Gangaur Ghat.
No checked site names a weekly closing day, but reserve Sheesh Mahal, Ambrai and Jagat Niwas thalis ahead, and remember photography is banned in the Crystal Gallery.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and ticket details do not guarantee availability. HRH Hotels' pages (City Palace Museum, Crystal Gallery, car collection, Shiv Niwas, Garden Hotel and Jagmandir venues) give no street addresses, only named palace buildings, and list no closing days; HRH's published boat fares were valid only to 31 March 2026, so current fares were not confirmed, and boat hours are given only for undefined summer and winter seasons. The City Palace Museum's own site carries a 2025 footer and its e-ticket site failed with a certificate error. Raffles Udaipur's dining pages are undated; Ambrai's site is dated 2025 and publishes no hours; Palki Khana, the car collection and Bagore Ki Haveli publish no hours. The Leela's bar and Dining Room menus are labelled 2023. Sites that could not be read: Taj Lake Palace (HTTP 403), Hotel Lake Pichola/Upre (connection reset), Rajasthan museums department (DNS failure). Jagdish Temple, Sajjangarh/Monsoon Palace, Jheel's, Millets of Mewar and Bharatiya Lok Kala Mandal had no official site found. The Mewar Sound and Light Show is suspended till further notice. Two WebFetch reports of AI-addressed text (Leela home page, Garden Hotel contact page) only echoed the review prompt and were not reproduced on re-read, so they are not listed.
